title: IPC admin.endpoints.list result
description:
Every configured local endpoint with its effective state: config.yaml's endpoints with the state directory's endpoint overlay composed over them (ADR-0028 A 2026-10-11). `persisted: true` on every row: what admin.endpoints.set_enabled and set_default changed survives a daemon restart. A lease is a session's, not configuration: admin.endpoints.revoke stays runtime-only.

2.0.0 (ADR-0067 decision 7, IPC major 3): every EndpointId here is the derived id of `endpoints/endpoint-id` 2.0.0 -- the 52-character name of the endpoint's Ed25519 key -- and a label of the grammar ADR-0067 retired is refused; no reader of the earlier major tolerates the value, so the shape takes a major. One row is served on major 3 (LOCAL-IPC.md §Version negotiation and phases, one shape per document on 3.0): the row 2.5 brought, `persisted: true`. The `persisted: false` row -- all that 1.0.0 described, and what 1.1.0 kept for a major-2 connection below 2.5 (ADR-0017 A 2026-10-07) -- is sent on no connection of this major, a row the runtime cannot persist being answered `Internal` and not served. `persisted` stays a boolean, the shape 2.13 served.

persisted.description: true on every row major 3 serves: the row's enabled and default survive a daemon restart, kept by the state directory's endpoint overlay (ADR-0028 A 2026-10-11). false was the major-2 row below 2.5 and is sent on no connection of major 3.

lease.description: Present while a connection holds the lease.
